Reference / compression/zlib

compression/zlib#

zlib (RFC 1950): DEFLATE with a two-byte header and an Adler-32; what Content-Encoding: deflate holds (#183).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let packed = ZlibCompressed(data).bytes();
let data = ZlibDecompressed(origin: packed, limit: 10485760).bytes();

Description#

zlib (RFC 1950): DEFLATE with a two-byte header and an Adler-32; what Content-Encoding: deflate holds (#183).

A stream goes through the Compressing and Decompressing roles, for example with compression/read:

let packed = CompressedReading(origin: input, compressor: ZlibCompressor());

Decompression is bounded: limit is the most bytes it may produce, past which it throws CompressionLimitExceeded; damaged data is InvalidCompressedData.
